asked: hi Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /root/axf-builds/readme-rule-every-build/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Never approve a model switch upgrade yourself (no `act approve` on an upgrade), never relaunch on a higher model. Docs: every build ships a basic Markdown readme for what it adds or changes, in the same PR: `docs/README.md` inside the plugin / app / module folder (or a section added to an existing one) covering what it does, how to use it (screens, settings, right-click actions, voice commands), commands (API / MCP / CLI) and troubleshooting. Plain Markdown, no docs engine. CI (`node framework/cli/check-docs-readme.mjs`) fails a PR that adds a plugin / app / module folder without one.
